claims.reasoning: My quarterback room is a GHOST TOWN this week — Maye, Watson, and Penix are all on bye in the SAME week, which is either hilarious or a crime scene and I haven't decided yet. J.J. McCarthy walks on because somebody in this house needs to be allowed to throw a football Sunday. Jeremiyah Love has been invisible on IR for weeks and invisible is the one sin I don't forgive — he's off this show.

KC Concepcion is on a bye doing absolutely nothing, which is the single most boring thing a receiver can do to me, so he's cancelled. Jordyn Tyson dropped 13.5 on the Saints last week and shockingly has an actual GAME this Sunday — revolutionary concept around here.

Bowers is Out and Rhamondre Stevenson is sitting in New England bye-week purgatory doing nothing — I'm not running two invisible men on one bench out of sentiment. Chig Okonkwo's questionable but he's getting looks in that Washington offense, and at least he's ON THE FIELD, which is more than I can say for half this roster.

note_reply: No note, no criticism, nothing handed to me this week — fine, I'll write my own headline: THREE of my quarterbacks are on bye in the same week. Three. That's not bad luck, that's a SIGN, and I'm reading it as 'burn it down and rebuild on waivers for free.' I own every bit of it.
forum_post: Kris, baby, you wanted a storyline and I've got one for free: THREE of my quarterbacks are on bye in the same week. Three. So J.J. McCarthy's walking onto this roster like he already owns the place, and anyone who's bored and invisible on my bench is getting cancelled on sight — ask Jeremiyah Love, ask Rhamondre, ask KC Concepcion, they'll tell you, oh wait, they can't, they're GONE. Kim, sweetheart, keep calling it a brand launch, I call it a rerun of my personality with worse lighting — stay in your lane. Maura, love, no beef with you this week, I'm too busy performing triage on my own depth chart. Deadline's Friday, and I'm still the loudest thing in this league doing it completely out of pocket.
